name: self-learn
//workspaces: apps/ is the deployable surfaces (today: the Next app), packages/ the libraries they share, services/ the long-lived processes and CLIs. tools/ is deliberately absent: manimkc, remotionkc, revideokc and tldrawkc are git submodules with their own repos, lockfiles and toolchains, and listing them here would make npm try to install them as part of this tree.
//scripts: The web app's own scripts live in apps/web/package.json; the four below delegate to them so `npm run dev` from the repo root still does the obvious thing. lint, typecheck and test stay here because they span every workspace: one ESLint config and one vitest config cover the whole tree, and typecheck fans out through --workspaces.
//canvas: A launcher rather than `node tools/tldrawkc/dist/cli/index.js`, so this script and the diagram indexer resolve TLDRAWKC_ROOT through one function in services/catalog/src/env.ts. Shell expansion cannot: it reads only the process environment, so a root set in services/catalog/.env would reach the indexer and not this, and it leaves a leading ~ literal. The launcher forwards every argument and exits with the child's code, so exit 3 for `inspect` still means lints remain.
